editorial_notes.note: Preserve the actual Greek chapter division: this chapter has 66 units, not the familiar 81-unit Christian chapter division. Names and successive-son wording are retained exactly; no different editions supply missing entries or alter the clan allocations. Manasseh and half-Manasseh are distinguished in 6:47/56.
The retained bounded father-role connection preserves Samuel's sons Sani and Abia in 6:13 and Joel son of Samuel in 6:18. No Sani=Joel or Abia=Abijah identity equation is credited.

Moocha's sister and wife roles remain as supplied; Malecheth's 'his sister', the son-chain antecedents, Ozan/Seera wording, the resettlement pronouns, Sosek's brother phrase and the Netophati residence antecedent are not independently resolved. Retained local context links explain actual grammatical continuity without establishing a new parentage, gender, agent or identity.

The Ner-Kish-Saul parallels are bounded to the exact shared genealogy and Jonathan/Melchisoue/Amminadab names; Asabal and Isbaal are not equated. Esel/Asel, six-son figures and actual printed name lists are preserved without supplying a missing name or harmonizing another list.

Only supported retained source-target pairs receive completion credit. 7:12 and 7:19 remain empty/pending with zero credit. Full-book inventory, inherited metadata and technical pin checks are not newly completed review. Independent AI peer review is pending after this author freeze.
